## Pull request checklist

- [ ] This change was made on a feature branch and this PR targets `main`.
- [ ] The branch contains small, coherent milestone commits rather than one end-of-task dump.
- [ ] The change is focused and its description explains the relevant context or evidence.
- [ ] I ran the relevant narrow checks and `./scripts/dev-check.sh` when the change is repository-wide.
- [ ] I resolved every CodeRabbit comment or piece of feedback, or explained why a suggestion does not apply.
- [ ] If CodeRabbit is unavailable, I requested human review as the fallback.
- [ ] I requested explicit human review if this is a large, security-sensitive, architectural,
      release, or spec/format change.
- [ ] I will wait for the required checks and review before merging.

For codec or format changes, identify the affected specification, implementation, conformance
vectors, changelog, and documentation in the description.
